clips.title: The story
paras: At Thunder Bluff, Turak Runetotem sends young tauren druids to Moonglade to learn how to cleanse natural and unnatural poisons. The sacred haven is where apprentices begin mastering that art under Dendrite Starblaze, a night elf druid, as real poisonings demand more than practice.

Cenarius gave druids the power to purge virulent toxins with an incantation, and their charge is to protect the wilds. Turak Runetotem teaches that such magic needs a firm grounding. Before a druid uses it to clear a blight, they must understand venom’s physical toll and learn to treat it by ordinary means.

Turak sends promising acolytes north from Mulgore along sacred pathways to Moonglade. In its peaceful village of Nighthaven, ancient night elf mentors such as Dendrite Starblaze teach elf and tauren practitioners alike. Their shared study reflects the Cenarion Circle’s delicate truce, which rises above the political strife between Horde and Alliance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, friend. Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation. This gift is not to be taken lightly... And to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.
Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings young druid, I'm glad to see you ready and eager to learn about the curing of poisons.

While most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing. There has been a rash of animal poisonings at the Crossroads in the Barrens, and they're unable to bring it under control. Someone there has requested Moonglade for aid, so we are sending you there to aid them. This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real. Bear this in mind.
